title: Ungraded Lab: Improving SQL Generation with Reflection

notes.goal: Build an agentic SQL generation workflow that uses the reflection pattern and execution feedback to review and refine database queries.

steps.title: Setup Environment and Database
steps.what_happens: Imports necessary libraries, sets up the aisuite client, and populates a local SQLite database called products.db with mock transaction data.

steps.title: Generate Initial SQL (V1)
steps.what_happens: Takes the user's natural language question and the database schema to draft a first version of the SQL query using an LLM.

steps.title: Execute V1 and Review Text-Based Reflection
steps.what_happens: Runs the V1 query against the database to inspect its results, and tests text-only reflection where the model reviews the SQL without execution output.

steps.title: Refine SQL with External Feedback
steps.what_happens: Passes actual query execution results back to the LLM so it can evaluate real data outputs, catch subtle logic errors, and output a refined query.

steps.title: Run End-to-End Workflow
steps.what_happens: Combines all steps into a single automated pipeline that extracts schemas, generates V1, executes it, reflects using execution feedback, and executes V2.

notes.results: Our run successfully executed all steps without errors. The model generated initial and refined SQL queries, interacted with the SQLite database, and successfully used external execution feedback to evaluate and confirm the final query output.
